learning_outcomes.text: Explain the core disciplines of aerospace engineering and how they combine in a flight vehicle
Describe the physics of flight: lift, drag, thrust and weight, and how they balance
Relate atmospheric and space environments to vehicle design choices
Outline the systems-engineering lifecycle used to develop aerospace vehicles
Identify major career paths and the role of standards, safety and certification
Communicate design trade-offs clearly to non-specialist stakeholders

integrative_case: A student team is asked to outline, at concept level, a high-altitude atmospheric research platform: they describe the operating environment, the balance of forces, candidate structures and propulsion, and a systems-engineering plan with safety and trade-off reasoning for a design review.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
